evidence_tree.method: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.isolation: Only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, the diff, and git history were not consulted.

identification_of_the_leaf.reasoning: The scenario name pairs exactly two named effect sources: Black Cleaver (item id 3071) and Bloodsong (item id 3877). The leaf lives under 'support_events', and Bloodsong is the only support item (Bounty of Worlds upgrade line, 'Starter'/support class in data/economics-sourced.json) present in the pairing. Bloodsong's only timed debuff applied to an enemy champion is 'Expose Weakness'. Black Cleaver's Carve is an armor-shred effect on the attacker's combat path, not a support event.
identification_of_the_leaf.cross_check: No other support item in the cached data carries a 6-second window: Celestial Opposition (2 s linger / 1.5 s slow / 18 s cooldown), Dream Maker (8 s cycle / 3 s empower), Solstice Sleigh (2.5 s), Zaz'Zak's Realmspike (0.5 s delay), Bounty of Worlds / Runic Compass / World Atlas (20 s charge cycle). So 6.0 cannot be sourced from any support item in the roster.

independent_computation.statement: Bloodsong's Expose Weakness debuff duration is a flat constant read directly from the cached wiki effect text. No formula or level scaling is involved.
steps: 1. Locate the support item in the scenario pairing: data/items.json key '3877' -> name 'Bloodsong'.
2. Read its effect text through the branches list (passives[0] 'Spellblade', branches[0]) rather than a single indexed description.
3. The text states the champion-target rider verbatim: "If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds".
4. Duration = 4.0 s (flat). The other durations in the same sentence are the Spellblade arming window (10 s) and the effect's internal cooldown (1.5 s) - neither is the debuff duration.

5. Confirm 6.0 has a different, non-support home: data/items.json key '3071' 'Black Cleaver', passives[0] 'Carve', branches[0] states a 6-second stack duration, and docs/math-foundations.md Section 2.3 item 2 independently repeats 'The stack *duration* (6 s)' for Black Cleaver. 6.0 is therefore the correct Carve number but the wrong number for a Bloodsong support event - consistent with the old value having carried Carve's 6 s onto the Expose Weakness leaf.

sources_quoted.quote: After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.
sources_quoted.role: Rules out 6.0 as a Bloodsong number by showing where 6 s legitimately belongs.

sources_quoted.locator: Section 2.3, numbered item 2 (Black Cleaver average stacks), line ~314
sources_quoted.quote: The stack *duration* (6 s) is always longer than the engine's inter-swing interval for any realistic AS·u > 1/6, so expiry does not rescue the constant - this is a documented tuning constant, not a theorem.
sources_quoted.role: Second, independent attestation that 6 s is the Black Cleaver Carve duration, not a support-item duration.

negative_checks: grep of all cached support-item effect texts (World Atlas, Runic Compass, Bounty of Worlds, Celestial Opposition, Dream Maker, Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, Solstice Sleigh, Bloodsong) found no 6-second duration anywhere.
data/staleness.json records item 3877 Bloodsong as stale: false with no stat_drift, so the cached text is the current-patch text.
data/item-atoms/3877.json carries no numeric 'duration' parameter, so the wiki branch text is the only numeric source for this leaf and there is no competing cached value.
confidence_notes: The value is a flat constant with a verbatim quote in the cached wiki text; the only residual uncertainty is leaf attribution (that support_events[17] is a Bloodsong Expose Weakness application), which is supported by the scenario name, the 'support_events' key, and the absence of any other 6 s or 4 s support-item duration in the roster.
